title: Schedule of Application: Check and Electronic Check Payments Toward Payment Arrangements Installments
content:
**Schedule of application — payments above the previous bill made by check**
Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)

How much of the payment above the previous bill is applied to the installment being billed follows how the latest payment was made — the most recent payment posted to the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account, by posting date — and the account's returned payment record over the twelve months ending on the bill date.

| Latest payment posted to the service account | Returned payment posted in the twelve months ending on the bill date | Part of the payment above the previous bill applied to the installment |
|---|---|---|
| a check (paid at an office or by mail) or an electronic check | at least one | 50 percent (0.5) |
| a check (paid at an office or by mail) or an electronic check | none | 75 percent (0.75) |
| any other channel | — | in full |

**Notes**

1. The other channels are online card, phone (IVR) card, office cash, money order, payment kiosk, bank draft (autopay) and energy assistance agency payments.
2. Only the channel of the latest payment decides the line; earlier payments in the month do not.

**Hypothetical:** a payment above the previous bill of $40.00 is applied as $20.00 where the latest payment was a mailed check and a return was posted eight months before the bill date; as $30.00 where it was an online electronic check and no return was posted in the twelve months; and as $40.00 where it was an online card payment.
